quests.question: Leo feels the strong sun on his shoulders and quickly asks for a cold glass of water.
quests.hint: Notice what Leo asks for right after feeling the strong sun.
quests.explanation: Correct! Strong sun on his shoulders is exactly why Leo wants cold water.
quests.funFact: Drinking water often is an important way to stay safe in hot weather.
quests.wordExample: Leo asked for cold water on a hot afternoon.

quests.question: What is a fun activity to do outside when the air is moving strongly?
quests.hint: Think of the activity where a colorful toy soars high above you on a string.
quests.explanation: Great job! Flying a kite is a fun activity for a breezy day.
quests.funFact: The very first kites were invented in China thousands of years ago.
quests.wordExample: We went outside to fly a kite in the breeze.

quests.question: On a cold, windy day, what might you wrap around your neck before going outside?
quests.hint: Think about the cozy item wrapped around the neck for cold, windy days.
quests.explanation: Yes! A scarf is often wrapped around the neck for cold, windy days.
quests.funFact: Some scarves are long enough to wrap around the neck two or three times.
quests.wordExample: Dad tied his scarf snugly before facing the wind.

quests.question: What is a fun activity to do outside with a basket of food on a pleasant day?
quests.hint: Think of the outdoor meal you enjoy on a blanket spread over the grass.
quests.explanation: Great job! Having a picnic is a fun outdoor meal on a pleasant day.
quests.funFact: Picnics became a popular outdoor meal hundreds of years ago.
quests.wordExample: We packed a basket to have a picnic in the park.

quests.question: You might see icicles hanging from the roof in weather like this.
quests.hint: Think about the pointy, frozen drips that hang from rooftops.
quests.explanation: Yes! Icicles hanging from roofs are a classic sign of icy weather.
quests.funFact: Some icicles can grow to be longer than a grown-up is tall.
quests.wordExample: Icicles hung from the roof on an icy morning.

quests.question: Leo feels the icy air on his cheeks and quickly asks for his warmest mittens.
quests.hint: Notice what Leo asks for right after feeling the icy air.
quests.explanation: Correct! Icy air on his cheeks is exactly why Leo wants his mittens.
quests.funFact: Wearing mittens rather than gloves can help keep your whole hand warmer.
quests.wordExample: Leo asked for his mittens on a cold morning.

quests.question: On a hot, sunny day, what might you wear on your legs instead of long pants?
quests.hint: Think about the shorter leg covering worn instead of long pants in the heat.
quests.explanation: Yes! Shorts are often worn instead of long pants on hot, sunny days.
quests.funFact: Choosing shorts over long pants can help your whole body feel cooler.
quests.wordExample: I wore shorts instead of long pants on the hot day.

quests.question: This activity involves jumping into water and moving your arms and legs to float and glide.
quests.hint: Think about the water activity where you glide using your arms and legs.
quests.explanation: Correct! Moving your arms and legs to float and glide describes going swimming.
quests.funFact: Some animals, like dogs and horses, know how to swim naturally.
quests.wordExample: I love going swimming at the community pool.

quests.question: Leo looks outside and sees the whole yard covered in soft white flakes. He grabs his sled.
quests.hint: Notice what Leo grabs before he runs outside.
quests.explanation: Correct! A yard covered in soft white flakes is exactly why Leo grabs his sled.
quests.funFact: Sledding works best on a smooth hill covered in packed snow.
quests.wordExample: Leo grabbed his sled on a snowy morning.

quests.question: On a very sunny day, what might you wear on your head besides sunglasses?
quests.hint: Think about the head covering worn along with sunglasses on bright days.
quests.explanation: Yes! A sun hat is often worn along with sunglasses on sunny days.
quests.funFact: Wearing a sun hat is one more way to protect your skin from sunburn.
quests.wordExample: I wore a sun hat along with my sunglasses.

quests.question: On this kind of day, it is best to stay inside instead of playing on the playground.
quests.hint: Think about the powerful weather that makes outdoor play unsafe.
quests.explanation: That's right! Staying inside is the safest choice during stormy weather.
quests.funFact: Playgrounds are safest to visit once a storm has fully passed.
quests.wordExample: We stayed inside instead of playing outside during the stormy day.

quests.question: On this kind of day, it is smart to walk slowly and stay close to a grown-up outside.
quests.hint: Think about the hazy weather where it is harder to see people and things nearby.
quests.explanation: That's right! Staying close to a grown-up is a smart safety choice during foggy weather.
quests.funFact: Staying close together helps everyone stay safe when it is hard to see far.
quests.wordExample: We stayed close together during the foggy walk.

quests.question: This colorful sight often makes children point and shout with excitement after a rainy afternoon.
quests.hint: Think about the exciting, colorful sight children love to point at.
quests.explanation: Great choice! A colorful sight after rain that excites children is a rainbow.
quests.funFact: Many old stories from around the world try to explain how rainbows form.
quests.wordExample: The children shouted with joy at the bright rainbow.

quests.question: This item usually has a zipper or buttons and often includes a hood for extra warmth.
quests.hint: Think about the item with a zipper, buttons, and sometimes a hood.
quests.explanation: Great choice! A zipper, buttons, and a hood for warmth describe a warm coat.
quests.funFact: Coats with hoods can help keep both your head and neck warm together.
quests.wordExample: My warm coat had a cozy hood.

quests.question: On this kind of day, jumping in puddles with your rain boots is a fun activity.
quests.hint: Think about the wet weather that creates puddles perfect for jumping.
quests.explanation: That's right! Puddles form in rainy weather, perfect for jumping in boots.
quests.funFact: Jumping in puddles is a favorite rainy-day game for many children.
quests.wordExample: We jumped in puddles because it was rainy.

quests.question: A fun activity for this weather is flying a kite at the open park.
quests.hint: Think about the weather that helps a kite soar high in the sky.
quests.explanation: That's right! Windy weather is perfect for flying a kite at the park.
quests.funFact: A steady, gentle wind works better for kite flying than sudden gusts.
quests.wordExample: We flew a kite because it was windy.

quests.question: A great activity for this weather is flying a kite, since it is comfortable but not too hot.
quests.hint: Think about the mild, pleasant weather that makes outdoor play comfortable.
quests.explanation: That's right! Mild, pleasant weather is perfect for flying a kite outdoors.
quests.funFact: A gentle breeze on a warm day is often perfect for kite flying.
quests.wordExample: We flew a kite on a warm, pleasant day.

quests.question: A great activity for this weather is raking the leaves, since it is refreshing but not too cold.
quests.hint: Think about the mild, refreshing weather that makes yard work comfortable.
quests.explanation: That's right! Mild, refreshing weather is comfortable for raking leaves outdoors.
quests.funFact: Raking leaves is a common chore during cool autumn weather.
quests.wordExample: We raked leaves on a cool, refreshing day.

quests.question: A cozy activity for this weather is reading a book by the window.
quests.hint: Think about the calm, grey weather that feels perfect for reading indoors.
quests.explanation: That's right! Calm, grey weather can feel perfect for a cozy book.
quests.funFact: Soft, even light on cloudy days can be gentle on your eyes.
quests.wordExample: We read books by the window on a cloudy day.

quests.question: A great activity for this weather is having a picnic in the park with friends.
quests.hint: Think about the weather that makes outdoor picnics extra pleasant.
quests.explanation: That's right! Warm, bright weather is perfect for a picnic outdoors.
quests.funFact: Picnics became popular outdoor meals hundreds of years ago.
quests.wordExample: We had a picnic because the day was warm and sunny.

quests.question: A great activity for this weather is going swimming at the local pool.
quests.hint: Think about the weather that makes a cool pool feel extra inviting.
quests.explanation: That's right! Hot weather makes swimming pools feel extra inviting.
quests.funFact: Swimming pools are a popular way for people to cool off on hot days.
quests.wordExample: We went swimming because it was hot.

quests.question: This activity uses a long string to keep a colorful, paper toy soaring high above you.
quests.hint: Think about the outdoor activity where a paper toy soars on a long string.
quests.explanation: Correct! Using a long string to keep a paper toy soaring describes flying a kite.
quests.funFact: A steady breeze, not a strong gust, usually works best for flying a kite.
quests.wordExample: I love flying a kite on a breezy afternoon.

quests.question: This item comes in many colors and patterns, and it hangs down over your coat.
quests.hint: Think about the colorful item that hangs down over a coat.
quests.explanation: Great choice! A colorful item hanging down over a coat describes a scarf.
quests.funFact: A striped or patterned scarf can add a fun splash of color to a winter outfit.
quests.wordExample: My colorful scarf hung down over my coat.

quests.question: This activity means eating a meal outdoors, often on a blanket spread over the grass.
quests.hint: Think about the outdoor meal eaten on a blanket in the park.
quests.explanation: Correct! Eating a meal outdoors on a blanket describes having a picnic.
quests.funFact: Sandwiches and fruit are popular foods to pack for a picnic.
quests.wordExample: I love having a picnic on a sunny afternoon.

quests.question: This weather makes the pond hard enough on top that you must never walk on it without an adult.
quests.hint: Think about the frozen pond top that can be dangerous without a grown-up.
quests.explanation: Correct! A hard, frozen pond top describes icy weather, and it needs adult supervision.
quests.funFact: Lakes freeze from the top down, which helps fish survive underneath.
quests.wordExample: The pond stayed icy and needed an adult nearby.

quests.question: A cozy activity for this weather is drinking hot cocoa by the window.
quests.hint: Think about the chilly weather that makes a mug of cocoa feel so cozy.
quests.explanation: That's right! Cold weather makes hot cocoa feel extra inviting.
quests.funFact: Hot cocoa can help warm you up from the inside on a cold day.
quests.wordExample: We drank hot cocoa because it was cold.

quests.question: This clothing item ends above the knee and helps keep you cool while you run and play.
quests.hint: Think about the clothing that ends above the knee for cool, easy play.
quests.explanation: Great choice! Clothing ending above the knee for cool play describes shorts.
quests.funFact: Many children wear shorts for sports and outdoor games in hot weather.
quests.wordExample: I wore shorts to run and play outside.

quests.question: On a scorching summer day, what activity helps your whole body feel refreshed and cool?
quests.hint: Think about the water activity that refreshes your whole body in the heat.
quests.explanation: Yes! Going swimming helps your whole body feel refreshed on a scorching day.
quests.funFact: Public pools often get much busier on the hottest days of summer.
quests.wordExample: Going swimming refreshed us on the scorching day.

quests.question: A fun activity for this weather is building a snow fort with your friends.
quests.hint: Think about the cold, white weather perfect for building things outside.
quests.explanation: That's right! Snowy weather is perfect for building a snow fort.
quests.funFact: Packed snow can be stacked like bricks to build a small fort.
quests.wordExample: We built a snow fort because it was snowy.

quests.question: This hat has an extra-wide brim, unlike a warm winter hat that covers your ears.
quests.hint: Think about the hat with an extra-wide brim, different from a warm winter hat.
quests.explanation: Great choice! An extra-wide brim, unlike a winter hat, describes a sun hat.
quests.funFact: Sun hats are usually made of light, breathable material to stay cool.
quests.wordExample: My sun hat had a very wide brim.
